written_by: development agent from the five catalog photos, before the first measured run; evaluator-only input (the author receives the request notes only)
identity_features: Rectangular front with softly squared corners: a slim, slightly bevelled acetate rim, wider at the outer corners, lens openings about twice as wide as tall
Tortoise (havana) acetate: mottled dark brown with amber/honey patches, polished (glossy highlights); the pattern reads on the front, the endpieces and the temples
Keyhole-free bridge with a flat top continuous with the brow line; the bridge is short and the lens openings are close together
Small metal rivets (two dots) at each hinge on the front's outer corners and on the temples
Slim temples that widen slightly at the hinge, gently curved, bending down behind the ear; tortoise on the outside, with a small metal 'Ray-Ban' lettering plate on the outer face near the hinge
Lenses: uniform dark grey (near-black), fully opaque-looking in the photos, a small white 'Ray-Ban' script logo printed in the upper outer corner of the left lens
Overall proportions: a compact, narrow front (not oversized), lenses fill the rims with little rim visible below the lens

conditions.photos: front, back, left, right and one three-quarter angled view (held out from the author)
